definition: Autonomy — Śiva's absolute freedom (svātantrya) to manifest, maintain, and withdraw the universe without being affected by it. The power of self-awareness that makes the world possible without making Śiva dependent on it.

sources.claim: svātantrya is Śiva's essential nature — the freedom to manifest without constraint
svātantrya as the defining characteristic of the Lord

translations.note: 'Autonomy' captures the self-governing aspect; 'freedom' is too broad; 'independence' implies a prior dependence that doesn't exist.
